Casual mobile game item card in the exact 3D render art style, lighting, materials, and composition of the reference images. In the center floats a single blue plastic sports water bottle, tilted at a dynamic 20-degree angle, occupying about four-fifths of the card height. True proportions with mild low-angle perspective, showing openings and rim contours as thin ovals. Small soft bevels, slim handle, delicate small cap parts. One soft key light from the upper left illuminates the smooth cylinder, transitioning into soft shade on the right. Background is a flat graphic radial sunburst of alternating golden yellow and warm orange rays beaming from behind the bottle to the edges. No cast shadows on the background, completely isolated floating game asset, clean, polished 3D render, no text, no words, no numbers, no markings, no card border or frame.

A 3D stylized game card asset of a beach umbrella, floating in the center of the frame and tilted at an angle, spanning about four-fifths of the card. The umbrella features a dome canopy with scalloped edges along the hem, made of alternating fabric panels in vibrant red, bright yellow, and warm orange. A slim, slender silver-white metal pole pokes out at both ends: a small neat tip protruding at the top apex of the canopy, and a long straight slim pole extending from underneath. Viewed from a low camera with mild perspective, so the rim is a tilted oval. Stylized smooth 3D render with small soft bevels matching the exact rendering style, lighting, and finish of the reference images. The cloth canopy is matte with soft, smooth shading turning smoothly into shade from one soft directional light. The slim silver-white pole has a subtle satin finish with one soft highlight. The background is flat and graphic, composed of tone-on-tone concentric circular rings in bright sky blue, cyan, and slightly darker blue rings, exactly matching the backdrop in ref2.png and ref3.png. No text, letters, numbers, frame, border, or watermark.

In the exact same 3D casual game icon art style and background as the reference images: A classic beach umbrella floating tilted at an angle, spanning about four-fifths of the card.
The umbrella has a single continuous smooth dome canopy divided into alternating radial panels of vibrant red, bright yellow, and warm orange (repeating red, yellow, orange).
The bottom hem of the canopy features a clean scalloped valance edge (wavy scalloped border rim).
Mild perspective from a slightly low camera angle, so the circular base opening of the umbrella canopy appears as a thin tilted oval.
A slim silver-white pole extends straight down from underneath the canopy, and the tip of the slim silver-white pole pokes out cleanly at the very top center apex.
The materials have smooth, stylized surfaces: the fabric canopy is completely smooth matte cloth with soft, gentle seams between panels and soft lighting turning into shade; the slim pole is smooth silver-white satin metal with a soft subtle specular highlight.
The background is identical to ref2.png: flat graphic tone-on-tone concentric circular rings radiating outward in sky blue and cyan.
No layered petals, no extra objects, no text, no frame.
